title: ChatGPT Reached 100 Million Users In Record Time
hook: ChatGPT made mass adoption feel almost instantaneous.
closing: That speed let one service shape global AI habits before rivals caught up.
question: Did adoption happen too fast?

segments.say: ChatGPT reached 900 million active users, turning an early rush into a lasting global habit.
ChatGPT needed 2 months to reach its milestone, collapsing the old app-adoption timeline.
ChatGPT serves 850 million free users, making its mass adoption expensive to sustain.
